verdict.rationale: Paxos is a stablecoin issuance and payments platform, so support for machine-payment protocols is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never mentions x402, ACP, MPP, AP2, or any protocol endpoint or SDK for them. What it does document is standard REST payments, orchestration, webhook and llms.txt material, none of which constitutes named agent-payment protocol support.
